description: ENS resolution: ENS name to address, or address to its primary ENS name (reverse lookup), read straight from Ethereum mainnet; found says when there is no record. Also the name's owner in the ENS registry, or its NameWrapper holder when wrapped (wrapped=true). Do not use to check an address is well formed (/v1/util/address) or that it is a wallet (/v1/evm/is-contract). No API key. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

address.description: Address to reverse-resolve. Use instead of name.

name.description: ENS name to resolve, such as vitalik.eth.

name: evm_ens
title: ENS name resolution
